added: On a computer, Ctrl-S (Cmd-S) saves the dance or program you're editing, Ctrl-N starts a new dance, Ctrl-F puts the cursor in the Collection's search box (Quick search anywhere else), Ctrl-, opens Settings, and Esc or Ctrl-W goes back, asking first if you have unsaved changes. A mouse's Back button goes back too.
Right-clicking a dance in the Collection, or a program in Programs, opens its ⋮ menu.
On a Mac, the menu bar has Settings…, a File menu with New Dance, Import Dances… and Close, the system's full-screen item, and Help › User Guide.
removed: On a Mac, the menu bar no longer has an Edit menu. Cmd-C, Cmd-X, Cmd-V, Cmd-Z and Cmd-A still work in text, and right-clicking text offers Copy.
